answer: One concrete defence is a slashable stake bond: every agent must lock a deposit — a jade seal of skin in the game — before it can transact. Attackers who wander in with thousands of fake identities must fund a separate bond for each one, and any detected misbehaviour burns that onyx-hard stake. Identity creation stays cheap, but each Sybil costs real capital, so the price of a flood scales linearly while honest agents pay once and keep trading.
